papers.title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks
papers.abstract: We present a scalable approach for semi-supervised learning on graph-structured data based on an efficient variant of convolutional neural networks which operate directly on graphs.
papers.translation_note: 当前为本地样例模式，未调用翻译模型。

papers.title: GraphSAGE: Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs
papers.abstract: We propose GraphSAGE, a general inductive framework that leverages node feature information to efficiently generate node embeddings for previously unseen data.
papers.translation_note: 当前为本地样例模式，未调用翻译模型。

papers.title: Graph Attention Networks
papers.abstract: We introduce attention-based neighborhood aggregation for graphs, enabling different weights to different nodes without expensive matrix operations.
papers.translation_note: 当前为本地样例模式，未调用翻译模型。
